reason: 该插件主要用于在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中按 agent 生命周期注入方法论指令，并提供可调用的检索与分析工具，属于面向智能体行为编排与会话行为约束的插件；次要能力包括文档式知识索引查询和本地设置开关。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在每个会话中注入方法论提示并提供相关检索与分析工具，同时支持设置页开关与配置。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that injects methodology guidance into each new agent session, exposes retrieval and analysis tools, and provides a settings interface for enabling and configuring its behavior.

capabilities: Injects additional system instructions on each agent creation
Registers analysis/retrieval tools available to agents
Supports plugin configuration via browser settings route
Provides bundled methodology/index data with optional external corpus fetch workflow
